metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean cosine similarity over distinct sampled item-embedding pairs, mapped to [0,1]. Padding is excluded. A value near 0.5 corresponds to mean cosine near zero; higher values indicate greater directional alignment, not measured recommendation diversity. Null means fewer than two samples, a zero-norm sample, or nonfinite embeddings.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample_count: Number of item embeddings sampled using a local seed-42 generator.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_counts: Counts of processed batches, malformed skipped batches, valid positions, finite margins, nonfinite margins and observed item categories. Valid requires nonzero sequence, positive and negative IDs. Category observations are zero because categories are unavailable. Margin summaries exclude nonfinite margins; inspect their count before interpreting summaries.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_eps: Measured small-margin threshold used by this probe, in logit units.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over finite valid training positions in evaluation mode. Uses supplied training negatives, not validation candidates. Null means no finite observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower 10th percentile of finite valid training margins; null if none exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of finite valid training margins below zero; null if none exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of finite valid training margins below pos_neg_margin_eps; null if none exist.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Null: item categories are unavailable in this benchmark. No category breakdown is measured.
